notes_for_editor: Thin record: one source, the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (map revised March 2016), which gives only a label, coordinates and elevation. Checked and empty for build date, design, staffing, fate and current status: the NHLR and FFLOS Georgia lists, the FFLA Georgia page (under construction), the Fannin County history page and a Wikipedia article on Hemp, Georgia. The elevation unit is not printed; it is read as feet because 3580 ft = 1091.2 m matches elevation_m. The name is the compiler's label (tower 200 is above 72). Search snippets not read, so not cited: a ghost-town listing that gives 2,425 ft for a Hemp Top location (conflicts with 3,580), and 1935 and 2024 topo maps titled Hemp Top, which may mean the summit rather than the tower. Worth checking on a USGS map and with the Georgia Forestry Commission.
